text: Done at 2437b097 (shared, JVM+JS). LtaFile lossless model (kind, matrix, src/dst VolGeom, subject, fscale, sigma) with codec; LtaInterpretation for types 0,1,2,14,15 reduced to the RAS pullback following FreeSurfer dev utils/transform.cpp (LTAchangeType, LTAgetV2V: movsrc->refdst) and utils/mri.cpp (MRItkReg2Native, MRIfsl2TkReg, MRIxfmCRS2XYZtkreg LIA); type 21 and unknown -> typed UnsupportedLtaType; LtaExpression writes RAS_TO_RAS. MniXfm (source->target RAS) and RegisterDat (TkRegGrids; ref tkRAS -> mov tkRAS) codecs + interpretations. Oracle freesurfer_linear: one transform encoded as ras2ras/vox2vox/registerdat/fslreg LTAs, register.dat and talairach.xfm, agreeing to 1e-5 mm; Torig from nibabel, FSLREG from fslpy toFlirt. FINDINGS: nitransforms 25.1.0 writes the reference geometry into the LTA src slot (inverted under FreeSurfer semantics), so it was not used as a writer. CAVEAT: native lta_convert/tkregister2/mri_vol2vol oracle pending P4.02. Stale untracked dir oracle/freesurfer/ (first draft) left on disk because deletion is not permitted to me; not committed.
